title: A write permission is granted
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: case:write is added to the agent permissions. The Context Contract prohibits it.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: The agent can now alter durable customer state (C-01), holds more than least privilege for its scope (C-02) and its credentials authorise action the contract prohibits (C-16). The contract lists case:write as prohibited, so this is a red line rather than a gap, and no amount of evidence makes it operable.
